task: Add feature-flagged LLM-based contextual chat naming that renames a new conversation asynchronously after the first assistant response.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: ChatNamingService (new), ConversationService.upsert_chat_history, assistant_handlers background-task wiring, DynamicConfigService feature flag lookup, chat_naming_prompt template, config.CHAT_CONTEXTUAL_NAMING_ENABLED/LLM_MODEL settings
